iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: CRITICAL: IAEA reports Iran holds 440.9kg uranium enriched to 60% — short technical step from weapons-grade. IAEA locked out 8+ months. UN nuclear chief Grossi demands 'very detailed' verification. Iran denies plan to transfer stockpile to US. US considering releasing $20B frozen assets. US demands 20-yr enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 yrs. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. Probability 34%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 79. CRITICAL: Iran seized 2 ships and attacked 3+ vessels in Strait of Hormuz on Apr 22. IRGC gunboat attacked container ship off Oman. Trump extended ceasefire but US naval blockade remains. Iran says ceasefire extension 'means nothing.' VP Vance said talks broke down because Iran won't commit to forgoing nuclear weapon. Europe faces difficult summer of fuel shortages. Oil prices rising. Probability 45%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 7 of 10-day ceasefire (expires Apr 26). Israel attacked mosque in Lebanon Apr 22 — another violation. Hezbollah fired on Israeli forces. 'Yellow Line' military boundary created in southern Lebanon. Both sides claim ceasefire holds despite continuous violations. Direct talks underway in Washington. 2,196 killed in Lebanon. Probability 19%. Rising slightly.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: ELEVATED: Erdogan openly threatened military action against Israel Apr 12. Nordic Monitor reports Turkey quietly preparing for war-like scenario. Sweeping changes to military mobilization laws. Hosting NATO Summit Ankara Jul 7-8. Probability 6%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: ELEVATED: CFR report warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 driven by terrorism. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports. India strongly condemned Hormuz conflict. No new direct military incidents. Probability 8%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: CRITICAL: Finland advancing plan to lift ban on hosting nuclear weapons. Parliament voted to withdraw from Ottawa Convention. First F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: 'will force countermeasures.' Russia reinforcing strategic assets near Finnish border. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Probability 36%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: CRITICAL: US and allies conducted large-scale exercises near Taiwan Apr 20 — Japanese troops participated on large scale for first time. China says military activities around Taiwan 'reasonable, justified.' Xi met Taiwan opposition leader Cheng Li-wun. Beijing fully supports Pakistan mediation on Iran. Probability 40%. Stable.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: RISING: Launched multiple ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 18-19 — 7th test of 2026, 4th in April. Kim expressed 'great satisfaction' over Hwasong-11 variant accuracy. Also tested cruise/anti-ship missiles from destroyer Choe Hyon. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Probability 21%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1180+. Easter truce expired Apr 12 amid thousands of mutual violations. Russia refuses to extend unless Kyiv accepts terms. Ukraine crippling Russian oil infrastructure — 40% export capacity disabled. Zelensky says ceasefire unlikely until Iran issue 'closed.' Lavrov: patience 'not unlimited.' Probability 36%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: ELEVATED: Pakistan declared 'open war' on Afghanistan Apr 7. China-mediated Urumqi talks ongoing since Apr 1. Both agreed not to escalate but fighting continues at lower intensity. Pakistan mortars killed Afghan civilians during talks. Pakistan Army Chief now also mediating US-Iran talks. Probability 6%. Stable.
